text:
Priya Nair: Noticing ~45 customers got duplicate refunds in NetSuite after last night's billing job. Stripe shows single refund rf_z9Qw, NetSuite has two credit memos.
Owen Li: yikes. duplicates only in NS?
Priya Nair: yes, Stripe has one refund id per customer. NetSuite CM numbers differ.
Harper (eng): any infra changes in the window?
deploy-bot: deploy complete: release/2026-03-25-02:10 by @Harper
Harper (eng): we deployed a small change to our edge proxy to normalise vendor headers; saw a rollback later but maybe some traffic hit the new path.
Owen Li: our webhook handler checks HMAC header exactly at "x-stripe-signature". If header was rewritten to "stripe-signature" or had extra whitespace it could fail verification and trigger replay.
Priya Nair: logs show verification error then replay creates a second credit memo: 
```
ERROR billing:webhook - HMAC missing for evt_rf_z9Qw
INFO billing:replay - reprocessing evt_rf_z9Qw attempt=1
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit memo CM-2211 for refund rf_z9Qw
INFO netsuite-sync - created credit memo CM-2212 for refund rf_z9Qw (replayed)
```
Owen Li: root cause looks like header mutation at the edge + idempotency keyed on full raw request (headers included). Fix plan: 1) make HMAC lookup tolerant (strip spaces, case-insensitive keys), 2) change idempotency key to use stable fields (stripe_event_id + refund_id), 3) edge rule: do not touch signature headers for /webhooks.
Harper (eng): will push a hotfix to the edge to stop mutating signature headers and revert the vendor normalization for webhook routes.
Priya Nair: for remediation, can we auto-void duplicates where external_ref matches and created_at delta < 15m? Estimated 45 accounts. Need approval to auto-void and create reversal notes.
ops-bot: ticket FIN-6123 created: "Edge header mutation caused webhook replay duplicates" assigned to Harper, priority P1.
Harper (eng): will also add a regression test simulating header mutations and replay behavior. Owen will open PR for idempotency change.
Owen Li: PR opened. Added unit tests and integration test that fakes header-case changes.
finance-bot: Approval request sent to finance-approvals for automated void (max 50 accounts).
Priya Nair: approved pending hotfix confirmation. Harper, ping when edge is stable.
Harper (eng): hotfix deployed at 1720014400, edge logs show signature header preserved. Monitoring looks clean.
Owen Li: idempotency change merged. Backfill dry-run shows 45 matches; planned run scheduled at 1720015900.
Priya Nair: running backfill now after dry-run. Will post results to #finance-updates. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
